description.en:
G1 is AgiBot's wheeled, dual-arm platform for collecting robot-training data and developing embodied-intelligence applications. Its adjustable body spans working heights of roughly 130 to 180 cm, allowing it to reach different work surfaces while retaining a mobile base. The platform supports alternative end effectors, including dexterous hands and two-finger grippers.

The development workflow combines teleoperation, recording, data-quality tools and learned-policy deployment. AgiBot describes VR and motion-capture input options, wrist force sensing and multiple cameras for observing manipulation. Its GDK exposes control, navigation and model interfaces, making G1 a development system for testing tasks across industrial, commercial and domestic-style environments.
